name: AI Tools Hunt

sources.title: Homepage — live AI tools directory claiming 4,200+ tools, 140+ categories, weekly updates
Submit Your AI Tool — form with two options: 'Get Priority Review — $15' or 'Free Listing – $0 – Not Guaranteed'

conditions: A $0 'Free Listing' option exists on the form but is explicitly labeled 'Not Guaranteed' — the guaranteed path is $15 priority review
requirements: AI tools only; pick one AI Tool Category on the form
Required fields: tool name, website URL, category, description, logo/favicon URL, your name, email, consent checkbox
Optional: company/founder name, LinkedIn or X URL
Consent: 'I confirm that I am authorized to submit this tool' — submit as owner or authorized agent
Manual review implied by the priority/free split
preparation: Tool name, website URL, category, description
Submitter name, email, company/founder name, LinkedIn/X URL
workflow: Fill the required fields including logo/favicon URL
Choose 'Free Listing – $0 – Not Guaranteed' or 'Get Priority Review — $15'
Tick the authorization consent and Submit
Listing appears in the directory under the chosen category if approved
watchFor: Free tier has no guarantee — it may never be reviewed/published
Small WordPress directory despite the '4,200+ tools, 140+ categories' claims — self-reported numbers
Refund Policy page exists — read it before paying the $15
Form fields are mostly text + URLs — no file upload; the logo must already be hosted
countsAsLive: The tool appears in the aitoolshunt.com directory under its category with a View link
unknowns: Free-tier review turnaround (or whether it happens at all)
What 'priority review' turnaround is — no SLA stated
